perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information includes:

- Patricia has seemed more withdrawn and down than usual at work, which stands out because he remembers her as usually vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard her on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning and offered to share budgeting tips; she said she was overwhelmed with bills and would take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he apologized/checked in. She told him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his help.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend.
- Later, he checked in with her again; she said she was doing fine and planning a quiet weekend at home. He offered to be there if she needed anything.
- In a later exchange, she said she was busy but handling things and appreciated his support.
- He has continued to check in with her and offer help, including something as simple as grabbing a coffee.
